A '''longsword''', also known as '''war sword''', was a type of single-bladed [[Sword/Legends|sword]]. As the weapon was designed for battle, the blades were usually made of the finest metals. A two-bladed version of the war sword was the [[double-bladed sword]].<ref name="KotORCG" />

==History==
[[File:Skytri-Gamer1.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A S'kytri wearing a longsword.]]
Longswords were used in many cultures, including the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] before the invention of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Most [[Sith sword]]s were war swords treated with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] that produced a deadly [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] weapon.<ref name="KotORCG" />

Longswords were used by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Species/Legends|species]], whose warriors preferred to employ bladed weapons in combat situations. In Nagai society, fighting exercises were a daily ritual, and longswords&mdash;along with [[Swiftcut foil]]s and [[Tehk'la blade]]s&mdash;were used in some of these exercises. Participants fought both as a form of [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] and in attempts to claim victory and earn social status among their fellow Nagai.<ref name="Gamer" />

War swords were carried as a backup [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] by [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] warriors<ref name="KotORCG" /> as well as [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="SWRGRCR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Longswords were first mentioned in ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series]]'', an article written by [[Rich Handley]] and [[Joseph Bongiorno|Joe Bongiorno]] that was included in the [[Star Wars Gamer 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine. The issue was published in [[September]] [[2000]].<ref name="Gamer" />
